[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''P. Nelis''' was an [[Police officer/Legends|enforcement officer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celen]].<ref name="IC 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], he assisted [[Squad 40]] from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] in an operation to capture [[Jilam Kester]]. Despite observing Kester's [[Jilam Kester's base|hideout]] for a few days, Nellis and his colleagues were not able to account for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Iri Camas]]'s presence. Camas sacrificed himself to distract Squad 40, thereby allowing Kester to escape.<ref name="IC 501st" />
